# Math.net

> > Comprehensive K-12 math learning platform covering arithmetic, algebra, geometry, trigonometry, and probability with interactive tutorials and reference materials.

Math.net provides structured educational content across all major K-12 mathematics domains, from foundational arithmetic through advanced trigonometry. The site combines conceptual guides with reference materials to support both learning and quick lookup of mathematical definitions and techniques.

## Key Topics

- Trigonometric functions
- Right triangle
- Unit circle
- Sine, Cosine, Tangent
- Quadratic formula
- Algebra fundamentals
- Geometry basics
- Polygons and Polyhedra
- Probability and Statistics
- Solving equations
- Variables and Functions
- Arithmetic operations
- Plane geometry
- Set operations
- Math education

## Foundation & Arithmetic

- [Primary Math](https://www.math.net/primary-math): Guide to elementary math foundations, arithmetic, and measurement systems
- [Counting](https://www.math.net/counting): Tutorial on counting basics, skip counting, and number sense fundamentals
- [Addition](https://www.math.net/addition): Guide to addition with commutative and associative properties explained
- [Multiplication](https://www.math.net/multiplication): Tutorial on multiplication using partial products, arrays, and area models

## Algebra

- [Algebra](https://www.math.net/algebra): Introduction to elementary algebra with variables and equation solving
- [Variable](https://www.math.net/variable): Reference on variables, parameters, and coefficients in algebraic equations
- [Function](https://www.math.net/function): Reference on functions with vertical/horizontal line tests and one-to-one functions
- [Solving equations](https://www.math.net/solving-equations): Guide to solving equations using quadratic formula and algebraic techniques

## Trigonometry

- [Trigonometry](https://www.math.net/trigonometry): Guide to trigonometry with functions, right triangles, and unit circle
- [Sine](https://www.math.net/sine): Reference on sine function using right triangles and unit circle
- [Cosine](https://www.math.net/cosine): Reference on cosine function in trigonometry and unit circle context
- [Tangent](https://www.math.net/tangent): Reference on tangent trigonometric function and ratios

## Geometry

- [Geometry](https://www.math.net/geometry): Overview of plane and solid geometry with points, lines, and polyhedra
- [Line](https://www.math.net/line): Reference on lines, angles, perpendicular and parallel relationships
- [Plane](https://www.math.net/plane): Reference on planes, 2D geometry, and coplanar spatial relationships
- [Shape](https://www.math.net/shape): Reference on 2D and 3D shapes including polygons and polyhedrons

## Probability & Statistics

- [Probability and Statistics](https://www.math.net/probability-and-statistics): Guide to probability and statistics fundamentals with sample space concepts
- [Random variable](https://www.math.net/random-variable): Reference on random variables, discrete/continuous types, and distributions
- [Basic set operations](https://www.math.net/basic-set-operations): Reference on set theory operations: unions, intersections, complements

## Home

- [Learn and Practice Math - Math.net](https://www.math.net): Math.net homepage covering K-12 math topics from primary to calculus
